name: Kamidere
source:
Shinya is a 2nd year student at Nijiuki Gakuen, who also takes care of the family shrine. One summer day, he awakened as one of the Seven Gods of Fortune (shichifukujin), Hotei. Lucky thing for him as the other six gods were all bishoujos at his school! However, they don't seem to get along well with him, calling him a monkey and shaming him endlessly. The principal Youko, who was the goddess Amaterasu, instructed them to work together to restore the people's faith.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/09/01/september-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
信也是虹辉学园的二年级学生，同时负责打理家族神社。一个夏日，他觉醒为七福神之一的布袋。幸运的是，其他六位神灵都是他学校的美少女！然而，她们似乎和他相处得不太好，叫他猴子还不停地羞辱他。身为天照大神的校长阳子指示他们合作，以恢复人们的信仰。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/09/01/september-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
